description: This file contains shell script functions for configuring and managing a direct IP network protocol within an OpenWrt environment. It includes initialization, setup, and teardown routines, as well as interactions with external tools and scripts for device management and network configuration.

methods.name: proto_directip_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration parameters for the direct IP protocol, defining default values and available options.

methods.name: proto_directip_setup
methods.description: Sets up network interface by configuring the device, verifying the device type, setting PIN if necessary, and initiating DHCP and IPv6 configurations.

methods.name: proto_directip_teardown
methods.description: Teardown routine that stops the direct IP connection and updates network status.
